summary.text: Katrina Couch Ray-Saulis is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican John Reny.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, and is an adjunct instructor in the Maine Community College System.

paragraphs.text: Couch Ray-Saulis earned a bachelor's degree from the New Hampshire Institute of Art in 2015 and an M.D. from the University of Southern Maine in 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her biography said she has been a union leader for many years and an advocate and activist for longer.
She described herself in the survey as an active member of MSEA-SEIU Local 1989 and SOMSEA and as a union organizer.
Couch Ray-Saulis listed worker's rights, healthcare access, cost of living and education as the policy areas she is passionate about.
She said her campaign messages center on fair wages, education, affordable housing and food, and that government should reflect the lived experiences of the people it serves.
